raw:
These ten hypotheses come from reading the 100 results, not from running any further experiments. The pattern I relied on is that the most reliable interaction is between an edit and the operation it replaces. Where the replaced op has no parameters (avg_pool or skip_connect), swapping in a conv gives a large gain. Where the replaced op is already a conv, the gain is small or negative.

The weakest evidence is for hypotheses 6, 9 and 10. Their support rests mostly on the all-avg_pool or all-skip_connect parents, with only one or two contrasting cells.
